name: NetworkChangeWindowPlanner
tagline: Plan network engineering works into the maintenance window, through CAB and around change freezes – with clash detection and customer notices built in.
description: A complete network change-management app for telecom operators, ISPs and infrastructure teams: dashboard, week change calendar with freeze periods and drag-to-reschedule, CAB approval board, change register and impact view. Standard, Normal and Emergency (ECAB) changes with allowed transitions, clash detection on shared elements and regions, maintenance-window and lead-time rules, customer-notice due dates by risk, suggested risk, rollback and outcome capture, bulk actions, undo and a phone layout. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped, then connects to a collection, Dataverse, SharePoint or SQL table, a model-driven view or the Power Pages Web API.
features: Week change calendar with freeze periods, nightly capacity and drag / keyboard reschedule
CAB board with Standard, Normal and Emergency (ECAB) transition rules
Clash detection on shared sites / elements and domain + region; regional concurrency limit
Change freeze rules with freeze exceptions
Maintenance-window, minimum lead time, 48-hour unapproved and overrun warnings
Customer planned-works notices with due dates by risk
Suggested risk, rollback plan and outcome capture
KPIs: next 7 days, awaiting CAB, clashes, freeze violations, notices due, customers impacted, success rate
Bulk CAB booking, notices, implementer, status and CSV export
Undo, back/forward, search and filters; phone, tablet and desktop layouts
